test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_sizes_pruned (p UInt64, k UInt64, j JSON(a UInt64, b String)) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_sizes_pruned SELECT number % 1000, number, concat('{"a":', toString(number % 11), ',"b":"', toString(number % 7), '"}') FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM prewhere_sizes_pruned WHERE p = 999 AND j.a > 5 AND j.b = '3'
